rules.statement: Hold state in an auto-property, static or instance, private included, rather than a field; keep a field only when it is a const or enum member, a ref field, a fixed-size buffer, a volatile field, a field of a struct with [StructLayout] or [InlineArray], or a field used by reference (passed to a ref/out/in/ref readonly parameter such as Interlocked, Volatile, LazyInitializer or a benchmark input, taken with ref or &, or a mutable struct mutated through the field).
rules.why: The conventions prefer auto-properties, and a field is needed only where code uses its storage by reference or its layout is a contract; the repository's analyzer fails the build (NCID0001) on any other field.
rules.check: Look for new field declarations that are not one of the listed exemptions; in repositories that load the analyzer, leave this to the build rather than raising it in review.

rules.statement: When code reinterprets a struct's fields as contiguous memory (for example through Unsafe.As or MemoryMarshal to read them as one span), declare the struct with an explicit [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] (or another explicit layout) so the layout is recorded as a contract.
rules.why: The field layout is a contract the reinterpreting code depends on, and the attribute both documents it and keeps the fields legitimately as fields.
rules.check: Find Unsafe.As<TStruct, T>, MemoryMarshal.Cast or similar over a struct's fields and verify the struct carries a [StructLayout] attribute.

rules.statement: In a Roslyn analyzer test project, compile test snippets with CSharpCompilation against the test host's TRUSTED_PLATFORM_ASSEMBLIES and run the analyzer through CompilationWithAnalyzers instead of using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing.
rules.why: Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing downloads reference assemblies from NuGet while tests run, which breaks hermetic tests.
rules.check: Look for a reference to Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing packages or reference-assembly downloads in analyzer tests.

rules.statement: Do not suppress a build-failing analyzer rule that the repository declares unsuppressible (such as the field-versus-auto-property rule) with #pragma warning disable, [SuppressMessage] or an .editorconfig severity; change the code to an auto-property or a genuine exemption instead.
rules.why: The rule must be kept by the build, not by review, so no suppression is allowed.
rules.check: Look for #pragma warning disable, [SuppressMessage] or .editorconfig severity entries targeting the rule's diagnostic ID.
